sources.entry: Electronic WeChat - Better WeChat on macOS and Linux.

summary.one_liner: An unofficial, Electron-based WeChat desktop client for macOS and Linux (and Windows builds), now archived and no longer maintained.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a desktop wrapper around Web WeChat that adds native-app behavior on macOS and Linux. Listed features include blocking message recall, drag-and-drop photo sending, mentioning users in group chats, and sharing subscribed articles to services such as Weibo, Qzone, Facebook, Twitter, Evernote, and email. It also removes URL link redirects so links open directly. Build scripts exist for macOS, Linux, and Windows (32 and 64 bit). The maintainer states the project is no longer in active development and is kept as an archive for learning.
use_cases: run WeChat on a Mac desktop
send photos by drag and drop in WeChat
share WeChat articles to social networks
how_to_run: npm run build:osx (or build:linux, build:win32, build:win64) to package the app
Alternatively, install via Homebrew: brew cask install electronic-wechat
notable: Wraps Web WeChat in a native-feeling desktop app
Share subscribed articles to multiple external services
Removes URL link redirects to open blocked sites directly
Available via Homebrew cask per the README
caveats: No longer in active development; the maintainer says it is archived
Tencent has blocked third-party clients, which the README cites as the reason the project lost its purpose
The master branch is under development and not guaranteed stable; the README points to the production branch for builds
